question: Why does the seer lose all sense of direction and comfort?
premises: The mouths appear fang-terrifying and death-fire-like.
The speaker asks the world-abode for grace.
inference: The terrifying cosmic form overwhelms ordinary orientation and refuge.
uncertainties: The fused form dṛṣṭvaiva is treated as one surface token.
plain_english: Seeing your fang-terrifying mouths, like death-fire, I know no directions and find no comfort; be gracious, lord of gods, abode of the world.
